positions.name: DecisionRatification
positions.frame: what does this record ratify as settled, load-bearing outcomes?
positions.why: The 'Key decisions:' header (src-2) performs the act of ratifying what follows as settled determinations, and src-3 and src-4 are the items it ratifies — instrument identity and calibration specification. All three share the conviction read of 'decision' (performed settling act), the authority-ranking relational read, and the matter-of-fact-to-technical register. The frame asks what the record treats as decided rather than merely claimed.

positions.name: CalibrationVerification
positions.frame: how is the calibration finding established as authoritative and then re-entered into the record?
positions.why: Both expressions carry the same technical register (domain jargon used natively), the same competence value read, and the same specific calibration content (88.4 MHz, June reference plates). The tension the set holds: src-1 asserts the calibration as an unhedged claim by the Lead Astronomer, while src-4 re-enters the same finding as a ratified decision under Xena's 'Key decisions' header. The frame holds both sides — the movement from expert assertion to recorded decision — without resolving the conviction gradient between them.
